# Register reference {#registers}

This appendix lists the registers of LiteSPI. It is generated from the register
definitions of the gateware, elaborated on two reference designs for the Arty A7
platform without running an FPGA toolchain: these configurations are elaborated only,
not built nor run on hardware. Both add a flash with `SoC.add_spi_flash`; the first
uses the SDR PHY, the second the 1:2 PHY. Offsets are in bytes from the base of the
bank; the base addresses depend on the SoC and are in the `csr.csv` of a build. A
LiteX SoC names the bank after the `name` argument of `add_spi_flash`, `spiflash` by
default.

| Configuration | Target and options |
|------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| `sdr` | `digilent_arty` `rate="1:1"` `mode="4x"` `S25FL128L(READ_1_1_4)` `clk_freq=25e6` `with_mmap_write="csr"` `master_with_irq=True` |
| `ddr` | `digilent_arty` `rate="1:2"` `mode="4x"` `S25FL128L(READ_1_1_4)` `clk_freq=25e6` `with_mmap_write="csr"` `master_with_irq=True` |

Access is `rw` for a register written by software (`CSRStorage`, or a `CSRStatus` that
software also writes, such as event pending bits cleared by writing 1), `ro` for a status
(`CSRStatus`) and `wo` for a write-only strobe (`CSR`). The reset value of a `CSRStorage`
register ends its description. A register wider than 32 bits takes several
32-bit words of the bus, most significant word first. The BIOS
and `liblitespi` use these names through the generated `csr.h`
(`spiflash_phy_clk_divisor_write()`, for example), so they never need the offsets.

## SPI flash {#reg-spiflash}

Defined by `LiteSPI` (`litespi/__init__.py`).

The registers come from three blocks of the core, named by their prefix: `phy_` for the
SDR PHY ([PHYs](#phys)), `mmap_` for the memory-mapped frontend ([Memory-mapped reads
and writes](#mmap)) and `master_` for the register master ([The register master](#master)).
Which registers a build has depends on its configuration:

| Registers | Present when |
|------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| `phy_clk_divisor`, `phy_mode` | SDR PHY (`rate="1:1"`, also `LiteSPIXilinxUSPHY`); absent with the 1:2 PHY |
| `mmap_clk_divisor` | MMAP present (`with_mmap=True` and a module given) |
| `mmap_dummy_bits` | MMAP present and `with_csr=True` (default) |
| `mmap_write_config` | MMAP present and `with_mmap_write="csr"` |
| `master_cs` to `master_clk_divisor` | `with_master=True` (default) |
| `master_ev_status`, `_pending`, `_enable` | `with_master=True` and `master_with_irq=True` (set by `add_spi_flash` when the CPU has an interrupt named after the core) |

The table below gives the offsets of the `sdr` configuration. The 1:2 PHY of the `ddr`
configuration has no `phy_` register, so the offsets of the other registers differ:
software uses the names of the `csr.csv` of its own build, never these offsets. In the
`ddr` configuration `mmap_clk_divisor` and `master_clk_divisor` exist but have no
effect, since SCK is the PHY clock.

`phy_mode`: the clock generator uses bit 1 only, as the idle level of SCK
(`litespi/clkgen.py`); write 0 for mode 0 and 3 for mode 3. In both modes the PHY
changes its outputs on the falling edge of SCK and samples on the rising edge.

`master_rxtx` is a LiteX `CSR`, a register with separate write and read data: the
Access column shows `wo` for its type, but software also reads it to pop the RX FIFO.

The `master_ev_` registers hold one event, `rx_ready` (bit 0): its pending bit is set
when the RX FIFO goes from empty to holding a word.

Bank `spiflash`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `phy_clk_divisor` | `0x0000` | 10 | rw | SCK divisor of the SDR PHY: SCK = sys / (2 x ceil(div / 2)), sys / 2 for div 0 to 2. The reset value is the `default_divisor` of the PHY, computed by `add_spi_flash` from `clk_freq`. Used when a transfer carries a 0 divisor. Reset `0x4`. |
| `phy_mode` | `0x0004` | 2 | rw | SPI mode: write 0 (mode 0) or 3 (mode 3). Only bit 1 is used, as the SCK idle level (CPOL); bit 0 (CPHA) is ignored: the PHY always shifts out on the falling edge and samples on the rising edge of SCK. Reset `0x0`. |
| `mmap_clk_` `divisor` | `0x0008` | 10 | rw | Divisor of the MMAP commands, sent with each transfer. 0: use `phy_clk_divisor`. Ignored by the 1:2 PHY. Reset `0x0`. |
| `mmap_dummy_bits` | `0x000c` | 8 | rw | Dummy phase of the MMAP read command, in bits at the address width (dummy cycles x address lines). The reset value is `dummy_cycles` x `addr_width` of the module for a fast read, else 0. Present with `with_csr=True` (default). Reset `0x8`. |
| `mmap_write_` `config` | `0x0010` | 1 | rw | Bit 0 `write_enable`: 1 sends the Wishbone writes to the chip as page programs (`program_cmd` of the module), 0 acknowledges and drops them. The MMAP sends no write enable (WREN) itself. Present with `with_mmap_write="csr"`. Reset `0x0`. |
| `master_cs` | `0x0014` | 1 | rw | Chip select of the master, one bit per CS line: 1 selects the chip (CS low) and holds the PHY through the crossbar, 0 ends the command. Reset `0x0`. |
| `master_` `phyconfig` | `0x0018` | 24 | rw | SPI PHY settings. Reset `0x0`. |
| `master_rxtx` | `0x001c` | 32 | wo | Write: push one transfer of `phyconfig.len` bits, right aligned, to the TX FIFO. Read: pop the 32-bit word shifted in during one transfer from the RX FIFO. |
| `master_status` | `0x0020` | 2 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `master_clk_` `divisor` | `0x0024` | 10 | rw | Divisor of the master transfers, sent with each transfer. 0: use `phy_clk_divisor`. Ignored by the 1:2 PHY. Reset `0x0`. |
| `master_ev_` `status` | `0x0028` | 1 | ro | This register contains the current raw level of the event trigger. Writes to this register have no effect. |
| `master_ev_` `pending` | `0x002c` | 1 | rw | When an event occurs, the corresponding bit will be set in this register. To clear the Event, set the corresponding bit in this register. |
| `master_ev_` `enable` | `0x0030` | 1 | rw | This register enables the corresponding events. Write a ``0`` to this register to disable individual events. Reset `0x0`. |

Fields of `master_phyconfig`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `len` | 5:0 | SPI Xfer length (in bits). |
| `width` | 11:8 | SPI Xfer width (1/2/4/8). |
| `mask` | 23:16 | SPI DQ output enable mask (set bits to ``1`` to enable output drivers on DQ lines). |

Fields of `master_status`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `tx_ready` | 0 | TX FIFO is not full. Write rxtx only when set: a write to a full TX FIFO is dropped. |
| `rx_ready` | 1 | RX FIFO is not empty. |
